title: Follow-up to GCLI-126: pin refusal-to-edge fixtures, external-last rebind, S3 .condition reads, control-flow tests
description: Non-blocking notes from the Opus round 1 review of opum-ai/glyph-cli#206 (GCLI-126, landed 86ee6c3). N1: pin a fixture for the refusal-to-edge moves: 'import f' then 'from x import f', and 'from z import f' (z unresolved) then 'from x import f' both now give x.f, which is correct. N2: 'def f' then 'from numpy import f' (external last) now reads as rebound with no edge; it could return external when every remaining binding is external. N3: src/python/calls.ts:3759 and :3810 still read S3's .condition, so the single-hop and module-attribute paths over-refuse. N5: tests for while-else, 'if True:', finally nested in an if or with, and an except-bearing outer try around try/finally. Ordinary, not on the hold list.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A fixture in test/python-hops.test.ts pins both N1 cases to the single edge x.f, red on the pre-GCLI-126 base and green after
N2 is decided: either an external result when every remaining binding is external, or a test pinning the current no-edge behaviour with the reason
The S3 .condition reads at the two calls.ts sites named in N3 are removed or each shown not to over-refuse by a fixture
Tests exist for while-else, if True, finally nested in an if or with, and an except-bearing outer try around try/finally
The five-pin corpus delta is reported with every created or removed in-repo edge
